verses.text: At that time Jesus walked through the grain fields on a Sabbath day. His followers were hungry, so they began to pick some heads of grain and eat them.
When the Pharisees saw this, they said to him, "Look! Your followers are doing something that is against the law on the Sabbath."
He answered, "Have you not read what David did when he and his men were hungry?
He went into the house of God, and he and his men ate the holy bread. That was against the law for them. Only the priests were allowed to eat it.
And have you not read in the Law that the priests in the temple break the Sabbath rules, but they are not guilty?
I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.
The Scriptures say, 'I want mercy, not sacrifice.' If you had known what this means, you would not have judged people who are not guilty.
The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."
Jesus went on from there and went into their synagogue.
A man with a shrivelled hand was there. Some people were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus. So they asked him, "Is it against the law to heal on the Sabbath?"
He said to them, "If any of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will you not take hold of it and lift it out?
A person is worth much more than a sheep! So it is right to do good on the Sabbath."
Then he said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He stretched it out, and it was healed, as healthy as the other one.
But the Pharisees went out and made plans to kill Jesus.
Jesus knew about this, so he left that place. Large crowds followed him, and he healed all who were ill.
But he warned them not to tell other people about him.
This made come true what the prophet Isaiah had said:
"Here is my servant whom I have chosen, the one I love, who makes me very happy. I will put my Spirit on him, and he will announce justice to the nations.
He will not argue or shout. No one will hear his voice in the streets.
He will not break a bent reed, and he will not put out a flickering lamp, until he makes justice win.
The nations will put their hope in him."
Then some people brought Jesus a man who was blind and could not talk because he had a demon. Jesus healed him, so that he could both talk and see.
All the people were amazed. They asked, "Could this be the Son of David?"
But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, "This man drives out demons only by the power of Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons."
Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said to them, "Every kingdom that fights against itself will be destroyed. Every town or family that fights against itself will not last.
If Satan drives out Satan, he is fighting against himself. So how can his kingdom last?
And if I drive out demons by the power of Beelzebul, by whose power do your own people drive them out? So they will be your judges.
But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come to you.
"How can anyone go into a strong man's house and steal his things, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can rob his house.
"Whoever is not with me is against me. And whoever does not help me gather is scattering.
So I tell you, people will be forgiven for every sin and every insult against God. But anyone who insults the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
Anyone who speaks against the Son of Man will be forgiven. But anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this world or in the world to come.
"If you make a tree good, its fruit will be good. If you make a tree bad, its fruit will be bad. A tree is known by its fruit.
You family of snakes! You are evil, so how can you say anything good? The mouth speaks what fills the heart.
A good person brings good things out of the good stored up inside them. An evil person brings evil things out of the evil stored up inside them.
But I tell you that on the day of judgement, people will have to explain every careless word they have spoken.
By your words you will be found not guilty, and by your words you will be found guilty."
Then some of the Pharisees and teachers of the law said to him, "Teacher, we want to see a miraculous sign from you."
He answered, "Evil and unfaithful people ask for a sign! But no sign will be given to them except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
Jonah was in the belly of a huge fish for three days and three nights. In the same way, the Son of Man will be in the heart of the earth for three days and three nights.

The people of Nineveh will stand up on the day of judgement with the people of today and show that they are guilty. The people of Nineveh turned away from their sins when Jonah preached to them. And now someone greater than Jonah is here.

The Queen of the South will stand up on the day of judgement with the people of today and show that they are guilty. She came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomon's wisdom. And now someone greater than Solomon is here.
"When an evil spirit comes out of a person, it goes through dry places looking for rest, but it does not find any.
Then it says, 'I will go back to the house I left.' When it arrives, it finds the house empty, swept clean and tidy.

Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more evil than itself. They go in and live there. And in the end that person is worse off than before. That is how it will be for these evil people of today."
While Jesus was still talking to the crowd, his mother and brothers were standing outside. They wanted to speak to him.
Someone told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside. They want to speak to you."
Jesus replied to him, "Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?"
He pointed to his followers and said, "Here are my mother and my brothers!
Anyone who does what my Father in heaven wants is my brother and sister and mother."
